documents.title: Audited financial statements
documents.text:
Audited financial statements — Osprey Group (fictional).
In this document "OGH" means Osprey Group. Osprey Group reports capex of $7.3m for FY2025 on a reported basis under the original agreement. Osprey Logistics subsidiary reports net debt of $323.7m for FY2024 on a reported basis. OGH reports cash margin of 6.4% for FY2025. Osprey Group reports available liquidity of $47.6m for FY2024 on a reported basis. For Osprey Group, the permitted acquisitions basket is read as: capped at the greater of $15m and 20% of EBITDA. For Osprey Group, the sponsor equity cure is: no equity cure right. The fiscal year of Osprey Group ends on 30 June.

documents.title: Lender presentation
documents.text:
Lender presentation — Osprey Group (fictional).
Osprey Group reports capex of $5.4m for FY2025 on a reported basis under the amendment no. 1 (supersedes). Osprey Group reports net debt of $283.1m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Osprey Group reports revenue of $311.6m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Osprey Group reports interest cover of 7.4x for LTM to 30 Jun 2025. For Osprey Group, the permitted acquisitions basket is read as: uncapped where pro forma leverage stays below 4.0x. For Osprey Group, the sponsor equity cure is: equity cure available twice over the life of the facility.

documents.title: Compliance certificate
documents.text:
Compliance certificate — Osprey Group (fictional).
Osprey Group reports cash margin of 5.9% for FY2025. Osprey Group reports available liquidity of $57.8m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Osprey Group reports revenue of USD 235.4 million for FY2025 on a reported basis. Osprey Group reports interest cover of 5.8x for FY2025 (fiscal year ending 30 June 2025). "available liquidity" has the same meaning as "liquidity".
